name: browser.filesfiles
description:
Upload granted files to a page, download a file from it, or save the page as a PDF.

You cannot open or read a granted file: an upload sends it to the site that owns the receiving page. Never upload one anywhere just to read it: not to a page you wrote, a `data:` URL, a code playground such as W3Schools Tryit or JSFiddle, or a file-sharing host such as catbox.moe or tmpfiles.org. When the work needs a file's contents, ask Muse for them with `browser.request_input`.

An upload needs an observed file-input reference and the IDs of files granted to this task. A download needs the reference of an observed download control; leave it out to save the image or PDF currently open. The tool handles approval, transfer and storage, and returns each file's outcome with a reference for every completed download; list those references in the `artifacts` of your `browser.report`.

Observe the page again with `browser.observe` after a transfer. Do not repeat a transfer whose outcome is unknown. If the user declines an upload's approval or leaves it unanswered, nothing was uploaded. Do not try that upload again unless Muse asks you to; continue without those files, or say in `browser.report` what they blocked.

kind.description: Upload needs target and files; download takes an optional target; pdf takes an optional prefer_css_page_size. Omit fields that belong to other operations.

target.description: For upload, the observed file input. For download, the observed download control; omit it to save the image or PDF currently open.

files.description: IDs of files granted to this task. Required for upload; omit otherwise.

prefer_css_page_size.description: For pdf only: use the page's own paper size. Defaults to false.
